def backend.newPostP (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : backend.BNames → IProp GF)
    (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.isBackend γ P (W γ) (Pk γ) b ∗
      backend.isStopChans γ b ∗
        backend.bOpen γ (Qp.half 1) ∗
          ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdStockN (), backend.bOpen γ backend.rdOpen) ∗
            backend.bViewC γ 1 (backend.vData P (D, { bks := ∅, ver := W64 0 })) true ∗
              backend.plHook γ func.nil ∗
                ownToks γ.wb backend.wbInit ∗
                  backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P D) ∗
                    backend.bkRPool γ P b ∗
                      backend.rdStock γ P b ∗ backend.dlInit γ ∗ backend.fkCl γ P D ∗ backend.srSlot b)

def backend.bkRPool (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.rdPool γ P b ∗ [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdPoolN (), backend.bOpen γ backend.rdOpen)

def backend.rdLoan (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γp, threadPool.isThreadPool backend.rdPoolNs γp (backend.rdTok γ P b) ∗ threadPool.ownThreadLoan γp)

def backend.rdStock (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  [∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdStockN (), backend.rdTok γ P b

    List.replicate m (), R

    ↑backend.rdPoolNs ⊆ E) : backend.rdPool γ P b ∗ threadTok ⊢ |={E}=> ▷ backend.rdTok γ P b ∗

theorem backend.bOpen_one_pool (γ : backend.BNames) : backend.bOpen γ 1 ⊣⊢ backend.bOpen γ (Qp.half
    1) ∗ ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate backend.rdPoolN (), backend.bOpen γ backend.rdOpen) ∗ [∗list]

def backend.rdPool (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ γp, threadPool.isThreadPool backend.rdPoolNs γp (backend.rdTok γ P b))

    (backend.rdPool γ P b)

theorem backend.rdPoolN_add_rdStockN : backend.rdPoolN + backend.rdStockN =
    sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat

theorem backend.newPost_pool (hT : threadBound GF ≤ backend.rdPoolN) (E : CoPset) (γ :
    backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk : backend.BNames → IProp GF) (b : Loc) (D :
    backend.Data) : backend.newPost γ P W Pk b D ⊢ |={E}=> backend.newPostP γ P W Pk b D

def backend.rdPoolNs : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"backend_readers"

def backend.rdStockN : Nat :=
  sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat - backend.rdPoolN

theorem backend.rdToks_pool (hT : threadBound GF ≤ backend.rdPoolN) (E : CoPset) (γ :
    backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (b : Loc) : ([∗list] _x ∈ List.replicate
    sync.rwmutex.actualMaxReaders.toNat (), backend.rdTok γ P b) ⊢ |={E}=> backend.rdPool γ P b ∗
    backend.rdStock γ P b

def backend.rdPoolN : Nat :=
  2 ^ 28

def backend.newPostKP (γ : backend.BNames) (P : backend.BParams) (W Pk K : backend.BNames → IProp
    GF) (b : Loc) (D : backend.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(backend.isBackend γ P (W γ) (Pk γ) b ∗
      backend.isStopChans γ b ∗
        K γ ∗
          backend.bViewC γ 1 (backend.vData P (D, { bks := ∅, ver := W64 0 })) true ∗
            backend.plHook γ func.nil ∗
              backend.rbOwn γ (backend.rbData P D) ∗
                backend.rdPool γ P b ∗ backend.rdStock γ P b ∗ backend.dlInit γ ∗ backend.fkCl γ P D ∗ backend.srSlot b)
